sloka: परिवार्य च तं सर्वे शैलं मोघोत्करा इव ।भिन्दिपालैश्च शूलैश्च निरुच्छ्वासमपोथयन् ।। ७.२१.३८ ॥
transliteration: parivārya ca taṁ sarve śailaṁ moghotkarā iva ।bhindipālaiśca śūlaiśca nirucchvāsamapothayan ।। 7.21.38 ॥

translations.english: And all of them, having surrounded him like dense clouds surrounding a mountain, crushed him with bhindipalas and spears until he was breathless.
